# DSH Remote Host

> One installable DSH bundle. Pair an Android phone to DeepSeek Harness over LAN or a public Host IPv4.

- Repo: https://github.com/w2112515/dsh-remote-host
- Android APK 0.2.0: https://github.com/w2112515/dsh-remote-android/releases
- Package id: `@w2112515/dsh-remote-host` 0.2.2
- Install: clone v0.2.2 → `sh scripts/setup.sh --bind YOUR_PUBLIC_IP` → `sh scripts/start.sh` → `node scripts/invite.mjs`
- Invite runs on the Host (SSH is enough). Terminal QR. Type the 8-digit code to confirm.
- Pairing admin is loopback web. Side path: `ssh -L 3180:127.0.0.1:3180 HOST` then Settings → Mobile access
- Nearby discovery is off. Backup `$DSH_HOME/remote-host-security.bin`
- `dsh plugin add` needs pnpm; still run setup --skip-npm for natives
- Stock npm `dsh` 0.1.1-rc.2: send/stop/policy yes; per-tap phone approval no
- Linux natives in `native/linux-x64/`. No Windows iroh. Do not put DSH web on a public hostname.
